full_prompt_en: A square painterly portrait shows a young woman in left-facing profile wearing a lavish headpiece of pale flowers, a small bird, and long red-orange feathers. The background is dark olive and brown with a worn vignette, close behind her face on the left and lighter mottled marks near the right shoulder. Her face fills most of the left and central frame. A pale forehead, straight nose, softly closed lips, and rose-tinted cheek are modeled with gentle tonal transitions, while one gray-green eye looks quietly to the left. Auburn strands escape from the gathered hair and run in fine lines past the ear and neck. Across the crown, cream blossoms and dark green leaves overlap in a dense band. A small yellow-olive bird with a pale wing rests near the upper center, its head directed left; a wide fan of white and rusty orange feathers spreads toward the right edge behind it. The top and right sides are crowded by this textured arrangement, contrasting with the relatively open shadow around the face. Below, a dark moss-green garment covers the shoulder and lower right, its patterned fabric partly softened into the background. Diffuse warm light from the upper left brightens the woman's brow, cheek, lips, and floral details, while the underside of the jaw and neck remain in deep olive shadow. Fine grain, scratched paint, and softly rubbed edges make the portrait resemble an aged print layered with oil-paint texture. The face is more carefully resolved than the headdress and clothing, whose brushy fragments partly merge with the background. No text is visible. The overall composition is intimate and fantastical, balancing naturalistic facial modeling with ornate organic texture and a restrained green, cream, and burnt orange palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式肖像呈现一名向左侧身的年轻女子，头上戴着由浅色花、小鸟与长红橙羽毛构成的华丽头饰。背景为深橄榄绿与棕色，带磨旧暗角；左边紧贴面部，右肩附近有较浅斑驳痕迹。她的脸占据左侧和中央大部分。浅额头、直鼻、柔和闭合的嘴唇与玫瑰色脸颊通过温和明度过渡塑形，一只灰绿色眼睛安静地看向左方。几缕红棕头发从束起的发间逃出，以细线落在耳旁和颈边。头顶奶油色花朵与深绿叶重叠成密集花带。一只黄橄榄色、翅膀浅色的小鸟停在上部中央附近，头朝左；身后白与锈橙羽毛如大扇向右边缘展开。顶部与右侧被这种有肌理的安排挤满，与脸旁相对开放的阴影形成对照。下方深苔绿衣服覆盖肩部和右下角，带花纹的布料部分柔化进背景。来自左上的漫射暖光提亮眉额、脸颊、嘴唇与花饰细节，下颌和颈部下侧留在深橄榄影中。细颗粒、刮擦颜料和柔软擦磨边缘使肖像像叠着油画肌理的旧印刷品。脸比头饰和衣服解析得更仔细，后两者的碎笔局部融进背景。没有可见文字。整体构图亲近而奇幻，以自然主义面部塑形平衡华丽有机肌理和克制的绿、奶油白、焦橙色域。
style_prompt_en: Painterly imagery blends softly resolved naturalistic modeling with ornate fragments of botanical and feathery texture. Muted olive, deep brown, cream, and burnt orange create an aged, earthy palette, with pale highlights concentrated near the focal passage. Surfaces carry fine grain, scratched pigment, and rubbed edges, giving the image the patina of a timeworn print. Delicate tonal transitions establish a smooth central volume, while nearby details break into layered strokes and textured shards. The darkest values surround the clearer area, forming a gentle vignette without a hard graphic border. Warm diffuse light catches selected upper planes and leaves lower recesses in olive shadow. Dense ornament collects to one side and across the top, balanced by quieter negative space on the opposite side. The overall effect is wistful and richly tactile, with selective precision preventing the abundance of texture from becoming visually chaotic.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画影像把柔和解析的自然主义塑形与华丽的植物、羽毛状肌理碎片结合。灰橄榄绿、深棕、奶油白和焦橙构成古旧土色域，浅亮部集中在焦点附近。表面有细颗粒、刮擦颜料和磨过的边缘，使图像带旧印刷品的包浆。细腻明度过渡建立平滑中央体积，相邻细节则碎成层叠笔触和有肌理的片段。最深明度围绕较清楚区域，形成柔和暗角却没有坚硬图形边框。漫射暖光抓住选定上部色面，让低处凹陷留在橄榄影中。密集装饰聚在一侧及顶部，由对侧较安静的留白平衡。整体效果怅然且触感丰富，选择性准确度使大量肌理不至于混乱。
theme_en: A young woman in profile wearing a bird-and-flower headpiece
theme_zh: 一名年轻女子侧脸佩戴鸟羽与花朵头饰
name: Thomas Dodd
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
